newsitem.title: USA: American Oilfield conditions on tender met.
newsitem.headline: American Oilfield conditions on tender met.

text.p: AOD Acquisition Corp, a subsidiary of American Oilfield Divers Inc, said Wednesday that all conditions in its offer to acquire Hard Suits Inc had been met.
As a result, the company said it would take up the deposited common shares of Hard Suits.
Among the conditions met were the valid deposit of at least 50.1 percent of the voting rights attached to all of the common shares of Hard Suits outstanding.
The composition of the Hard Suits board of directors will change to reflect AOD's majority shareholder standing.

AOD has extended to November 8 its offer to acquire all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Hard Suits of C$1.65, or US$1.2045, each to give all shareholders the opportuntiy to tender their shares.
American Oilfield Divers provides diving services, subsea products, marine construction and environmental services to the offshore oil and gas industry.
